content.text:
This is a PE32+ x86-64 executable. Interesting imports include:
- CreateRemoteThread
- CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Process32First, Process32Next (process enumeration)
- OpenProcess
- ReadProcessMemory
- VirtualAllocEx, VirtualFreeEx
- VirtualProtect, VirtualQuery

These strongly suggest process injection. There are also unusual sections named /4, /19, /31, /45, /57, /70, /81, /97, /113 — these look like COFF sections that may contain embedded data (possibly from objcopy of embedded resources or similar). Section /19 is large (0xb10e bytes).

Let me look at strings and disassembly.
